claim.reason: Original 2f plan jamb re-measurement with an independent labeled-dimension calibration, replacing the previous calibration that reused saved candidate wall coordinates. X scale: the row-2 top dimension chain extension lines (labeled 5000|4940|1120|3940|10000, total 25000) were located by green-ink profile profile_001: px 241=0.000, 470=5.000, 697=9.940, 748=11.060, 929=15.000, 1387=25.000 m (whole-chain 45.84 px/m; local 1120 segment 697->748 px = 45.54 px/m used for the conversion). Y scale: left chain extension lines (profile_002): px 341 = building top edge 20.000 m and px 522 = the 3940 chain line 16.060 m (= 20000-3940), 45.85 px/m; the host wall band spans px 518-524, centerline consistent with the retained host plane y=16.0646. Door evidence: cyan door-leaf/arc ink (profile_004/008 and 8x crop): west jamb = hinge side of the drawn leaf at px x=705 (+-1.5 px); east jamb = where the swing arc returns to the wall next to the wall-return stub at px x=741.5 (+-1.5 px). This clear opening is deliberately distinguished from the longer wall-face ink gap: the north wall-face ink run ends at the c002/c006 party wall (px 693-699) west of the hinge, and the south-face run resumes at px ~750 east of the arc return. Values p1/p2 keep the existing host plane y=16.0646; only x is updated.
unresolved: Jamb pixel readings carry about +-1.5 px (~0.033 m) uncertainty per endpoint; the door leaf ink band is 704-706 px and the arc return 740-742 px.
Local conversion uses the labeled 1120 mm chain segment (45.54 px/m); the whole 25000 mm chain gives 45.84 px/m, which moves the endpoints by <=5 mm and is included in the stated uncertainty.
Door height remains assumed 2.1 m above the 2f floor (no height dimension on the plan); swing state unknown.
Wall-face ink-run gap (party wall px ~694 to south-face resume px ~750) is NOT the door span; it was explicitly not used as the jamb span.
